wb.title: Word Builder
wb.subtitle: Coin new words that follow your language's sound and derivation rules. Every suggestion is editable before it reaches the dictionary.
wb.concept_hint: English or বাংলা, the meaning you want a word for.
wb.existing_note: This meaning already has a word; no need to invent a rival.
wb.root_hint: The base root this word was coined from.
wb.empty_body: The builder proposes a word consistent with your generated phonology and derivation rules, checks for collisions, and explains its reasoning. You edit everything before saving.
wb.toast_added: "{word}" added to the dictionary as a generated word.
tl.title: Translation Lab
tl.subtitle: Draft translations built from your own dictionary, word by word, with nothing hidden.
tl.disclosure_body: assembled by rules from your dictionary, not fluent machine translation. Anything the dictionary doesn't cover appears in brackets. And it stays private: the whole process runs on your device against your workspace's own storage — no external translation service sees a word.
tl.text_placeholder: e.g. We will review the contract
tl.copy_failed: Clipboard is not available in this browser context.
tl.save_note_placeholder: Note (optional) — when/why you'd use this phrase
tl.flag_privacy: Your text itself is never stored in the report.
tl.flag_done: Flagged. The audit entry records the direction and reason — never the text itself.
tl.no_mapping: No dictionary word matched anything in the source text.
tl.unmapped_line: Not in your dictionary yet: {words}; add them or use the Word Builder.
pb.title: Saved phrases
pb.subtitle: Your workspace's quick-reference phrasebook.
pb.empty_body: Translate something and press “Save to phrasebook” — with an optional note about when to use it — and it will be waiting here.
